messages:
tariq: weird one — after enabling automatic retries in the node SDK, we ended up with multiple different req ids for the same external request in staging logs. not sure if redaction rules missed the new header name or the retry middleware swapped ids.

zoe: can you paste a minimal trace from logs?

tariq: snippet: 
INFO handler start route=/create order=42 x-req-id=1111-aaaa
INFO http-client retrying attempt=2 x-request-id=2222-bbbb
INFO handler end route=/create req_id=3333-cccc status=200

zoe: ah — looks like three different keys: x-req-id, x-request-id, req_id. our redaction defaults to request_id + x-request-id, but not x-req-id or req_id aliasing. plus the retry client library sets x-request-id on retry which leads to multiple ids in same trace.

maria: ordering/serialization also matters: the client attaches a header and the retry wraps the request; sometimes the client log prints before the retry injects header. if our redactor only scans the final message string we miss earlier intermediate headers.

tariq: repro I ran: sdk with RETRY_ENABLED=true, RETRY_MAX=3 and REDACT_REQIDS=true, hit /create once. saw multiple ids across messages for same logical request. privacy risk if one variant isn't redacted.

zoe: short fixes: (1) expand redaction keys to include `req_id` and `x-req-id`, (2) ensure logger does per-record structured redaction (walk keys) not only final message regex, (3) normalize ids in retry middleware — e.g., preserve original request-id header on retries by copying instead of replacing.

maria: I'll open a small PR to: add aliases to redaction defaults, add a middleware to the retry client that preserves `x-request-id` on retries, and add a unit test simulating a retry that logs before/after header mutation. also add a note in sampleapp README about "retries can mutate request IDs; enable REDACT_REQIDS for all aliases."

ci-bot: build #5234 started for maria/retry-reqid-normalize :rocket:

tariq: thanks — once deployed I'll run a 1k replay against staging to validate no raw ids leak. leaving thread open until staging pass. last ping 2167005999
